gaps: state
Precinct and county figures for 115 contests

The Secretary of State published precinct workbooks for some offices only; for these the Official Vote Totals give the contest's figures for its whole area, and nothing smaller: Member, State Board of Education (5), Court of Appeals Judge (7), District Court Judge (77), District Magistrate Judge (26).
https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html
state
Write-in votes not given to a declared candidate
The Official Vote Totals print no write-in line, and only the sheets of Johnson, Shawnee and Wyandotte carry one (3,863 votes in all), so no contest-wide figure exists and none is stored.
https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html
precinct
84 precinct figures printed 'Redacted'

The Wyandotte sheets print 'Redacted' ('redacted per KSA 25-2701(a)(2)') where a precinct had so few voters that its figures could reveal how someone voted; those cells are not stored, and the county's Totals row, which includes them, is its county row.
https://sos.ks.gov/elections/election-results.html
